ciFixtureRoleMapping.note: CI login roles prove separation in PostgreSQL integration tests only — not production names.

checks.sql: SELECT session_user::text AS session_user, current_user::text AS current_user;

checks.description: Verify intended production runtime roles exist.
checks.sql: SELECT rolname, rolcanlogin, rolsuper, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN (:migration_owner, :general_app_runtime, :trusted_attestation_issuer) ORDER BY rolname;

checks.description: App runtime must not inherit issuer role; issuer must not inherit app runtime.
checks.sql: SELECT r.rolname AS member, m.rolname AS granted_role FROM pg_auth_members am JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = am.member JOIN pg_roles m ON m.oid = am.roleid WHERE r.rolname IN (:general_app_runtime, :trusted_attestation_issuer) ORDER BY 1, 2;

checks.description: Issuer INSERT+SELECT; app denied INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on attestations.
checks.sql: SELECT grantee::text, privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'battery_hv_charge_session_evidence_integrity_attestations' AND grantee IN (:general_app_runtime, :trusted_attestation_issuer) ORDER BY grantee, privilege_type;

checks.description: App may UPDATE revision/ACK; issuer SELECT-only on revision/ACK (no direct UPDATE).
checks.sql: SELECT table_name, grantee::text, privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('battery_hv_charge_session_evidence_revisions', 'battery_hv_charge_session_evidence_acks') AND grantee IN (:general_app_runtime, :trusted_attestation_issuer) ORDER BY table_name, grantee, privilege_type;

checks.description: Issuer may EXECUTE narrow lock function; app denied.
checks.sql: SELECT grantee::text, privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_routine_grants WHERE routine_schema = 'public' AND routine_name = 'm3_3_hv_h4_a3_lock_revision_and_ack_for_issuance_v1' AND grantee IN (:general_app_runtime, :trusted_attestation_issuer);

checks.description: Trusted functions owned by migration owner (not runtime roles).
checks.sql: SELECT p.proname::text AS function_name, pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner)::text AS owner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname IN ('m3_3_hv_h4_a3_lock_revision_and_ack_for_issuance_v1', 'm3_3_hv_h4_a3_invalidate_attestations_for_revision_v1', 'm3_3_hv_h4_a3_invalidate_attestations_for_ack_v1') ORDER BY 1;

checks.description: A3 attestation tables owned by migration owner.
checks.sql: SELECT c.relname::text AS table_name, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)::text AS owner FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname IN ('battery_hv_charge_session_evidence_integrity_attestations', 'battery_hv_charge_session_evidence_revisions', 'battery_hv_charge_session_evidence_acks') AND c.relkind = 'r' ORDER BY 1;

checks.description: pgcrypto extension available for fingerprint helpers (R1 migration prerequisite).
checks.sql: SELECT extname::text, extversion::text FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pgcrypto';

checks.description: Prisma migration history includes A3 attestation migrations.
checks.sql: SELECT migration_name FROM _prisma_migrations WHERE migration_name LIKE '%battery_hv_h4_a3_integrity_attestation%' ORDER BY finished_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20;

checks.description: Runtime roles must not CREATE in public schema.
checks.sql: SELECT nspname::text, pg_get_userbyid(nspowner)::text AS owner, has_schema_privilege(:general_app_runtime, nspname, 'CREATE') AS app_can_create, has_schema_privilege(:trusted_attestation_issuer, nspname, 'CREATE') AS issuer_can_create FROM pg_namespace n WHERE nspname = 'public';
